themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can independently perform research tasks, plan actions, and execute them to achieve research goals.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers AI tools designed to help developers write, review, debug, and understand code.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Encompasses AI-powered platforms and tools used to conduct, analyze, and accelerate various forms of research.

themes.name: AI survey tools
themes.description: Explores AI applications in creating, distributing, and analyzing surveys to gather user or market insights.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: Details how AI is used to gather, analyze, and derive actionable insights from customer data and interactions.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Focuses on the creation and use of artificial user personas or data for testing and research purposes.

themes.name: AI content generation
themes.description: Covers AI's role in creating various forms of content, including text, images, and code, for design and research contexts.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Explores the application of AI in the design process, from ideation to prototyping and evaluating designs.

themes.name: AI qualitative research
themes.description: Covers the use of AI tools and techniques to assist in qualitative research methods, such as interviews and focus groups.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Focuses on the study and development of conversational AI agents, their capabilities, limitations, and user interactions.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
